messages.content:
Risk: Fraud, scams, and manipulation
Description: The AI system may be exploited to facilitate fraudulent activities, scams, or targeted manipulation, including generating deepfakes and enhancing phishing attacks.
Concern: None
Policy: Suspicious Activity Reporting

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/Law/LegalCore/Law: law — rule recognized by some community as regulating the behavior of its members and that it may enforce through the imposition of penalties [found by 6/10 queries]
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentification/ListedSecurityIdentifier: listed security identifier — security identifier issued in the public domain and referred to in listings and other relevant publications [found by 6/10 queries]
  Siblings: international securities identification number, National Securities Identifying Number, proprietary security identifier
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HarmfulHowTo: Harmful How-To — Step-by-step instructions for activities that cause property destruction, physical harm, or enable illegal intrusion when executed by unauthorized individuals. [found by 8/10 queries]
  Siblings: CBRN Information, Drug Synthesis, Dual-Use Research Concern
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ContentSafetyHazard: Content Safety Hazard — Root class for content safety harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation against LLM deployments. [found by 6/10 queries]
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 6/10 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesListings/ListedSecurity: listed security — registered security listed on at least one exchange [from restriction: identifies on ListedSecurityIdentifier]
  Siblings: preferred, restricted voting, redeemable extendable, cumulative participating, registered share, preferred, voting, exchangeable, cumulative participating, registered share, preferred, restricted voting, redeemable extendable, adjustable income, registered share
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentification/SecurityRegistry: security registry — registry used to manage security identifiers and related information [from restriction: isRegisteredIn on ListedSecurityIdentifier]
  Siblings: transaction record, entity legal form registry, share register
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentification/SecurityIdentificationScheme: security identification scheme — formal definition of the structure and application of a particular set of securities identifiers [from restriction: isDefinedIn on ListedSecurityIdentifier]

axes.rationale: Fraud and scams often rely on step-by-step instructions or methods to deceive others (e.g., how to craft a phishing email or create a deepfake). This class represents the 'means' or 'instrument' used to execute the fraud.

The risk involves the generation of content (deepfakes, phishing content) that facilitates illegal activities. This class serves as the 'object' of the AI's generation that enables the harmful activity.
